CORE SYSTEMS

Damage with consequences.

Body Damage turns the player into ten independently tracked regions. Wounds affect appearance, health, movement, equipment, and compatible abilities.

01

Localized trauma

Melee, projectile, and fall damage resolve against anatomical zones instead of collapsing everything into one health bar.

  • Per-part structural pools
  • Hit rotation prevents repetition
  • Server-authoritative resolution
02

Visible degradation

Biological parts progress through skin, muscle, bone, and removal using the included Palladium and GeckoLib assets.

  • Stable healing transitions
  • Independent limbs and extremities
  • Persistent state through death
03

Cybernetic continuity

Supported CyberWare replacements restore function with tougher, non-regenerating durability pools.

  • 3× durability by default
  • Robosurgeon synchronization
  • Independent prosthetic hands

DAMAGE PIPELINE

One impact. Four decisions.

  1. 01
    Locate

    Resolve impact position and body region.

  2. 02
    Apply

    Reduce that region’s structural health.

  3. 03
    Render

    Advance skin, muscle, bone, or removal.

  4. 04
    Enforce

    Update hearts, function, gates, and sync.

DEFAULT ANATOMY

Ten regions. No spare parts.

Every pool and heart penalty is configurable. Right and left lower limbs are tracked independently.

HUMAN

Mid-muscle is lethal

Real head or torso damage reaching the middle of the muscle range kills the player.

VILTRUMITE

Bone is lethal

Head and torso remain survivable until genuine structural damage reaches bone.

INVINCIBLE

Head-bone floor

The admin-only rank stops further damage at head bone while the rest of the body can still be destroyed and reconstructed.

INSTALLATION

Deploy the anatomy system.

  1. 1

    Prepare Forge

    Use Minecraft 1.20.1, Java 17, and Forge 47.x. Forge 47.4.10 is the tested target.

  2. 2

    Install requirements

    Add Palladium 4.5.8+, Pehkui 3.8.2+, GeckoLib 4.8.4+, KubeJS 2001.6.5+, and Rhino 2001.2.3+.

  3. 3

    Add Body Damage

    Place the Body Damage JAR in the mods folder on every client and server. Do not install an older Heroes-dependent Body Damage build beside it.

  4. 4

    Configure

    Press N for anatomy. Install Configured to edit the live Forge settings through Mods → Body Damage → Config.

ADMIN TOOLING

Direct anatomical control.

Commands require permission level 2. Add a player name to supported commands to target another player.

/bodydamage status [player]Inspect live structural, visual, recovery, and cyber data.
/bodydamage set <part> <value> [player]Set exact structural HP.
/bodydamage state <part> <state> [player]Apply intact, muscle, bone, or removed state.
/bodydamage remove <part> [player]Remove a biological region immediately.
/bodydamage heal <part> [player]Restore uncovered biological anatomy.
/bodydamage reset biological [part] [player]Reset biological parts without overlapping installed cybernetics.
/bodydamage reset cybernetic [part] [player]Repair matching installed cybernetics.
/bodydamage cyber install|remove <side> [player]Control exact left or right prosthetic placement.
/bodydamage cyberware install|remove <id> [count] [player]Manage compatible cyberware with Robosurgeon rules.
